summary: Tiny shop-side strip with an unmapped house about 5 m to the east.
reasons: House roof close on east side, unmapped
Narrow strip beside shop and street
Houses and pool across the back

drivers.seclusion: An unmapped house sits about 5 m east of the strip, with more homes behind it. Shops on the west side.
drivers.access_and_room: Open to the street at the north end; the strip fits a couple of cars and is tight for a van.
drivers.traffic: Side street with parked cars; quiet but overlooked from the house and the street.
drivers.convention: Cars use the bays during the day; nearby signs set 1P and no parking limits.

flags: Unmapped house within 10 m on the east side
Narrow strip, tight for a van
No Parking and 1P signs on the adjoining street
sun_shade: Open to sun; the shop shades the west side in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Narrow bays behind the corner shop, off Long Street East
